note: Dravyas that must NOT inherit an existing archive frame through their usda[] binding. build_batches.py checks this before taking the reuse path, so a listed dravya falls through and gets its own generated image. Reviewed by hand: a frame is only rejected when the substance differs from it in colour, form or processing. Two names for the same material keep sharing.

dravya.alphonso-mango.name: Alphonso mango
dravya.alphonso-mango.reason: a distinct cultivar, smaller and deep orange

dravya.bajra.name: Pearl millet
dravya.bajra.reason: bajra is grey-green and larger than proso

dravya.bay-leaf.name: Bay leaf, Indian
dravya.bay-leaf.reason: tej patta is larger and three-veined; the frame is Mediterranean laurel

dravya.black-grapes.name: Black grapes
dravya.black-grapes.sharedFrame: Grapes, red or green (European type, such as Thompson seedless), raw
dravya.black-grapes.reason: the frame cannot be both red and green; black grapes need their own

dravya.chana-dal.name: Chana dal (split bengal gram)
dravya.chana-dal.sharedFrame: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, raw
dravya.chana-dal.reason: split yellow dal, not a whole chickpea

dravya.chickpea-black.name: Black chickpea
dravya.chickpea-black.sharedFrame: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, raw
dravya.chickpea-black.reason: kala chana is small and dark brown; the frame is pale kabuli

dravya.dry-coconut.name: Dry coconut (copra)
dravya.dry-coconut.sharedFrame: Nuts, coconut meat, dried (desiccated), not sweetened
dravya.dry-coconut.reason: copra is a whole dried half-shell; the frame is shredded desiccated coconut

dravya.dry-dates.name: Dry dates (chhuara)
dravya.dry-dates.reason: chhuara is pale and shrivelled; medjool is dark and plump

dravya.elaichi-banana.name: Elaichi banana (small)
dravya.elaichi-banana.reason: a small finger banana, not the standard cavendish in the frame

dravya.green-grapes.name: Green grapes
dravya.green-grapes.sharedFrame: Grapes, red or green (European type, such as Thompson seedless), raw
dravya.green-grapes.reason: shares the same ambiguous grape frame as black grapes, so both get their own

dravya.long-brinjal.name: Brinjal (long purple)
dravya.long-brinjal.reason: long slender fruit, not the globe eggplant in the frame

dravya.lotus-seed.name: Lotus seeds (makhana)
dravya.lotus-seed.reason: makhana is white puffed popped seed; the raw-lotus-seed frame is what kamal gatta looks like

dravya.masoor-dal.name: Split red lentil
dravya.masoor-dal.reason: split masoor dal, not the whole lentil

dravya.mishri.name: Rock sugar (mishri)
dravya.mishri.reason: irregular crystal lumps, not granulated sugar

dravya.mung-dal-split.name: Split mung dal
dravya.mung-dal-split.reason: yellow split dal, not the whole green bean

dravya.mustard-seed-black.name: Black mustard seed
dravya.mustard-seed-black.reason: whole dark seed, not ground powder

dravya.mustard-seed-yellow.name: Yellow mustard seed
dravya.mustard-seed-yellow.reason: whole pale seed, not ground powder

dravya.ragi.name: Finger millet
dravya.ragi.reason: ragi is dark red-brown; the frame is pale proso millet

dravya.raw-jackfruit.name: Raw jackfruit (kathal)
dravya.raw-jackfruit.reason: unripe kathal is pale green-white; the frame reads as the golden ripe fruit

dravya.red-amaranth-greens.name: Red amaranth greens (lal chaulai)
dravya.red-amaranth-greens.reason: lal chaulai is red-purple; the frame is the green leaf

dravya.red-yellow-capsicum.name: Red/yellow capsicum
dravya.red-yellow-capsicum.reason: covers yellow as well, which a red-pepper frame cannot show

dravya.small-brinjal.name: Brinjal (small round)
dravya.small-brinjal.reason: small round fruit, not the globe eggplant in the frame

dravya.white-onion.name: White onion
dravya.white-onion.reason: white skin, not the brown onion in the frame

dravya.white-peas.name: White peas (safed vatana)
dravya.white-peas.sharedFrame: Peas, green, split, mature seeds, raw
dravya.white-peas.reason: cream-coloured whole peas, not green split peas
